copy.title: Waiting on Peer Review
copy.headline: How long has each ticket been waiting for peer review?
copy.lede: Every open issue where development is finished and the work is waiting on another developer to review it. Aged from the moment it last moved into Dev Done / Peer Review.
notes: **This column is pure latency.** Nothing here needs more development work. It needs someone else's attention. Time accumulated here is finished effort sitting idle, and it delays everything downstream in the same way a QA backlog does.
